sources.entry: NoteGen - Local-first Markdown note-taking app that captures scattered information and organizes it into structured notes with AI.

summary.one_liner: NoteGen is a local-first Markdown note-taking app that lets you capture scattered information quickly and then organize selected records into structured notes with AI.
summary.what_it_does: NoteGen separates capturing from organizing: you save thoughts, voice recordings, screenshots, images, links, files, or todos as they occur, then filter records by tag, time, or type and select related items. AI can organize the selected material into a Markdown note using a template or a described structure, and the result stays editable in the built-in editor. Notes are stored as ordinary Markdown files in a workspace folder. The app includes a Markdown editor with source and visual modes, search and replace, and export/printing. It also offers a searchable knowledge base combining semantic retrieval with local text search, a canvas for flowcharts, mind maps, timelines and charts, and sync via GitHub, GitLab, Gitee, Gitea, S3-compatible storage, or WebDAV, plus local backups.
use_cases: capture notes and ideas quickly before organizing them
turn meeting fragments and screenshots into meeting notes
organize saved links and reading into a research note
prepare weekly reports from tagged records
ask questions over my notes and knowledge base with AI
sync Markdown notes across devices via Git or WebDAV
how_to_run: Download NoteGen for your platform from the README's Download section (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, or iOS).
Choose a workspace folder for your Markdown files.
Add a first record or create a note directly.
Configure an AI provider if you want AI features.
stack: AI model providers (configurable, OpenAI-compatible services mentioned)
notable: Capture-first workflow: save records now, select and organize them into a Markdown note later
Notes remain plain Markdown files in a user-chosen folder, usable with other editors or Git
Canvas workspace for flowcharts, mind maps, timelines, and AI-generated diagrams
Configurable separate models for chat, embeddings, reranking, OCR, image recognition, and audio
Agent mode, MCP server support, and installable Skills
caveats: Platform builds are marked Beta (Windows, macOS, Linux) or Alpha (Android, iOS)
AI features require configuring your own model provider
Sync requires an external service such as GitHub, GitLab, Gitee, Gitea, S3-compatible storage, or WebDAV
